description: Principles of Chemical Science is the chemistry entry point and carries no mathematics prerequisite: the source course states that there are no formal prerequisites and assumes one year of school chemistry. Advanced mathematics does not establish chemistry readiness. The evidence that does is school-level chemistry (symbols and formulas, the mole, balancing equations, simple stoichiometry, the parts of an atom), which unit 1 of this course diagnoses honestly before any new material; a learner without it continues in the course with unit 1 as the bridge.

alternatives.label: School chemistry foundations demonstrated (unit 1 diagnostic or prior evidence)
